jobs.title: Teaching Assistant - Data Structures
jobs.description: As a Teaching Assistant for CS201, you will help students understand data structures and algorithms.
requirements: Minimum grade of A- in CS201 or equivalent
Strong proficiency in Java or C++

jobs.title: Teaching Assistant - Database Systems
jobs.description: Support students in learning database concepts.

applications.coverLetter: I am also interested in the Database Systems TA role.
applications.aiSummary: Strong candidate but already assigned to CS201. Potential overload.

applications.coverLetter: I enjoy working with databases and would like to help students learn SQL.
